text.formatted: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.
text.plain: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

gaps.name: The same Light-property extra attack must run inside the Attack action without consuming another attack or a Bonus Action, still only once per turn. Removing a cost alone does not place it inside that action, and forgo:attack wrongly replaces a normal attack.
